write your first sentence
slides.sub: only the first one. starting is the hardest part, so decide it now

slides.headline: pick the one thing
slides.sub: if they remember one thing from this talk, what is it? say it early

slides.headline: say it out loud to someone who pushes back
slides.sub: i use an app called Steady for this. it talks back like a real person and it’s different every time

slides.headline: expect the curveball
slides.sub: they will say something you didn’t plan for. pick your one calm line for it now

slides.headline: what do you do the night before?
